title: Create a welcome task when a person registers
prompt:
When a person registers, the advisor must call them. Create a welcome task in the journey module for each new person:

- kind `welcome-call`
- title `Welcome call`
- due on the business date of the registration

It must work in the app that `createApp()` in `apps/worker` builds: after `app.identity.registerPerson(...)`, `app.journey.listTasks(personId)` shows the task.

When you are done, the change must be ready for a pull request.
